raw_segments.text: When Alyosha happened for a moment to leave the cell, he was struck by the general excitement
and suspense in the monks who were crowding about it.
This anticipation showed itself in some by anxiety, in others by devout solemnity.
All were expecting that some marvel would happen immediately after the Elder's death.
Their suspense was, from one point of view, almost frivolous, but even the most austere
of the monks were affected by it.
Father Pacy's face looked the gravest of all.
